youtube.title: If I Had to Start Investing From $0 in 2026, I'd Do This
youtube.description:
If I lost everything tomorrow and had to start investing from $0 in 2026, here's exactly what I'd do: 7 boring steps, in the order that actually works. No stock tips, no crypto, just the plan.

Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:21 Step 1: Find your number
1:00 Step 2: Build a safety net
1:30 Step 3: Kill high-interest debt
2:07 Step 4: Grab the free 401(k) match
2:34 Step 5: Open a Roth IRA
3:07 Step 6: Buy the whole market
3:44 Step 7: Automate it and wait
4:34 What if the market crashes?
5:00 What I wouldn't do
5:20 The whole plan

Numbers used in this video:
• 2026 IRS limits: 401(k) $24,500 employee contribution, IRA $7,500 (under 50)
• Average credit card interest rate around 21% (Federal Reserve G.19)

Which step are you on right now? Tell me in the comments.
